title.narrative: Livable, Resilient, and Water-Secure Cities Investment Program

description.narrative: The proposed investment program will support priority short- to long-term investments to (i) improve, expand, and sustain resilient urban areas, infrastructure, and services, and (ii) promote water security in 14 cities and 12 districts across the Mekong, Tonle Sap, and coastal regions. The program is expected to benefit over 2 million people, contributing to Cambodia's target of achieving universal access to safely managed water supply and sanitation, and livable and resilient cities.

Output: Climate- and disaster-resilient urban planning strengthened. Indicator: A law on urban planning, a law on land management, and a law on urban renewal and conservation endorsed by the cabinet.
